great.name: Bariatric Surgery
great.quote: 13. Bariatric Surgery: Hospitalisation Expenses incurred for bariatric surgical procedure and its complications thereof are payable... after a waiting period of 24 months.
great.explanation: Bariatric surgery is covered after a 24-month waiting period. You can claim for bariatric procedures once you have completed two years of coverage.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: 6. Coverage for Non-medical Items (Consumables) : If there is an admissible claim under the policy, then Items as per List I speciﬁed in this policy will become payable
great.explanation: Non-medical consumables listed in List I are payable when a hospitalization claim is admitted. This reduces your out-of-pocket expenses for items like bandages and syringes.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with insurer.
good.reference: Section III (Exclusions) > 1. Pre-Existing Diseases - Code Excl 01 (Page 7/12)
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage. This is a standard waiting period in the market.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
good.reference: Section III (Exclusions) > 2. Speciﬁed disease / procedure waiting period - Code Excl 02 (Page 7/12)
good.explanation: Specified illnesses and procedures have a 24-month waiting period. Claims for these conditions can be made only after two years.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: 3. 30-day waiting period - Code Excl 03 (Not Applicable for Accidents)
good.explanation: There is a 30-day waiting period for illness claims, but accidents are covered immediately. This is a common industry practice.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: 16. Automatic Restoration of Sum Insured : There shall be automatic restoration of the Sum Insured once by 100%... Such Restored Sum Insured can be utilized for all claims for subsequent hospitalization during the policy period.
good.explanation: The sum insured is automatically restored once by 100% during the policy year. This helps if your base sum insured is exhausted.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: 9. Pre-hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days immediately before the insured person is hospitalized.
good.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered for up to 60 days before hospitalization. This helps cover diagnostic tests and consultations.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: 10. Post Hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 90 days immediately after the insured person is discharged from the hospital.
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for up to 90 days after discharge. This supports recovery costs like medicines and follow-ups.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: 8. Air Ambulance... reimbursement... up to  Rs.2,50,000/- per hospitalization and maximum upto Rs.5,00,000/-  per policy year
good.explanation: Air ambulance transport is covered with limits of ₹2.5 lakh per hospitalization and ₹5 lakh per year. This can be critical in emergencies.

Note: Expenses relating to Associated Expenses will be considered in proportion to the eligible room rent/room category stated in the policy schedule or actuals whichever is less.
